description: MainActivity.java is an Android activity class that serves as the entry point for a Tic Tac Toe game app. It initializes the main screen, handles button clicks to start a new game either with a human or computer opponent, and launches the GameActivity with appropriate parameters.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: An Android activity class responsible for initializing the main interface of the Tic Tac Toe game and managing user interactions to start a new game.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Lifecycle method called when the activity is first created; sets up the UI and button click handlers.

methods.name: startGame
methods.description: Helper method to start the GameActivity, passing whether the game should start with a human player.
